name: Fast Feet Shuffle

instructions.description: Stand in a slight athletic stance with knees softly bent and chest lifted.
Move your feet rapidly in small alternating steps while staying in place or shuffling laterally.
Keep your weight light on the balls of your feet and your arms active for rhythm.
Slow the feet down gradually and return to easy standing at the end of the interval.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use brief intervals with crisp footwork.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use slower side-to-side stepping for a lower-intensity option.

commentsNotes: Keep the steps quick but small.
Avoid letting the heels slam heavily into the ground.
